summary_1line: Garuda bypasses divine defenses, slays serpent guardians, seizes the Amrita without drinking it, gains boons from Vishnu, and survives Indra’s thunderbolt.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda shrinks his body and slips through the spinning razor-edged steel wheel guarding the Soma.
Garuda blinds the two blazing serpent guardians with dust and tears them apart beside the radiant pot of Amrita.
Struck by Indra’s thunderbolt in mid‑sky, Garuda laughs and casts down a single magnificent feather while still carrying the Amrita.
